## Implementation Verification Review

Project: `projects/<project>/`

### Reviewer checklist

- [ ] Executed scope matches approved scope.
- [ ] Verification evidence is present.
- [ ] Required items are VERIFIED or their gap is explicitly recorded.
- [ ] Current evidence is used over stale historical metadata.
- [ ] No repair or redesign was performed as part of verification.
- [ ] Implementation-traceability checks pass.

### Result

- [ ] PASS
- [ ] PASS_WITH_GAPS
- [ ] NOT_VERIFIED
- [ ] BLOCKED
- [ ] FAIL
